acceptance_criteria.description: ProcessLease and CustodyLeaseRecord persist a validated ipv4/ipv6 provider family with provider-port metadata, and both normal close and orphan recovery pass the stored exact family to providerOwner.
A scan exception or any non-empty malformed/skipped result emits bounded value-free custody evidence and rejects launch before process spawn; valid empty scans remain transparent.
Untracked custody never reports already-exited solely from map absence and never invokes destructive native termination; recovery retains or transitions the durable lease as retryable.
Focused custody/session tests, build, and clean real-Tinto stdio READY/first-close-idle probe pass while the identity-bound Windows termination blocker remains unresolved.

closed_decisions: Persist the selected provider loopback family together with the provider port in both in-memory and durable lease state, and use that exact family for normal-close and orphan-recovery listener ownership checks.
A durable lease that contains a provider port without a valid provider family is malformed and must block launch through the existing bounded scan-failure evidence path.
Any custody lease scan exception, malformed entry, or skipped entry blocks a new launch after bounded value-free evidence; the manager must not continue into process spawn.
For identities absent from the adapter's tracked-process map, inspection absence is not exit proof and termination must remain retryable without invoking raw-PID native termination.
Identity-bound native Windows termination remains an explicit architecture blocker; this unit must preserve rather than disguise that blocker.

focused: pnpm vitest run tests/unit/process-lease.test.ts tests/unit/session-recovery.test.ts tests/unit/session-manager.test.ts tests/unit/tracked-process.test.ts

forbidden_changes: Do not edit files outside the eight owned files.
Do not treat an untracked identity as already exited, remove its retryable durable lease, invoke native raw-PID termination for it, or weaken custody ownership/descendant proof.
Do not default a missing durable provider family to IPv4 or ignore lease scan exceptions, malformed entries, or skipped entries.

Do not add dependencies, implement or claim an identity-bound Windows Job Object backend, remove the supported Windows row, change public MCP tools/schemas/dialog behavior, edit provider/Tinto sources, manifests, lockfiles, queue/blocker/release files, commits, branches, Jira, or pull requests.
objective: Resolve the independently certified durable-lease family, lease-scan fail-closed, and untracked-custody proof findings without claiming to solve identity-bound Windows termination.
